steps.label: Continue Hulkenberg's training at Visca Alba Tavern (Follower rank 4).
Take the Spirited Youth's bungee challenge — a sure thing at Courage 2.
Depart for the Giant Sandworm's Nest; read 'Pride and Persuasion' (choice: gain the upper hand).
Stop by the Midnight Sunsands.
Another runner ambushes the route — Catherina rematch (Follower rank 2).
Campfire materials, then play a game with Hulkenberg.
A human blocks the road, then the Greatworm swallows the party.
Escape Giant Sandworm's Belly inside 15 minutes — run past common foes, loot everything, and fight only the rare Red Elmenta.
Corner the culprit in the underground channel — Heismay joins the party (Follower rank 1).
Martira prep: take 'The Man-Eater in the Mine', buy informant notes, and stock up at Cattleracket Road.
Return to Kriegante Castle and settle the castle trials; use the dungeon time to push Merchant to rank 15 for More's Chapter Two task.
Clearing Kriegante Castle completes 'The Old Castle Town Kidnapper' automatically and raises Gallica to Follower rank 3.
Martira farewells: chat with the Cheerful Fairy and the Kind Old Woman, then talk with Bardon (Follower rank 1).
Hear the Elegant Performer's music and take 'The Queen of Cuisine: Heart'.
Debate Loveless at the King's Rock (answer: alcohol won't bring equality).
Set off for Man-Eater's Grotto; read 'Pride and Persuasion' (choice: scare them).
Komero stop: hand the ornament and journal to Neuras (Follower rank 1); take 'Relic Search: Inventor's Bequest'.
At Akademeia, study Gunner and Merchant, turn in More's Task Chapter One: Ordeal — More reaches Follower rank 3.
With Merchant at rank 15, immediately turn in More's Task Chapter Two: Solitude — More reaches Follower rank 4 and Chapter Three: Drifting opens.
Clear Man-Eater's Grotto for the bounty; on B5 collect the Gold Beetle between the two northern stairs before leaving.
Report to the Gloomy Youth and the Recruitment Centre.
Catch up with Maria (Follower rank 3).
Deliver the lost relic to Neuras: complete 'Relic Search: Inventor's Bequest' (Follower rank 2) and start 'Relic Search: Dregs of Destiny'.
Enter the Abandoned Tomb to recover Grius' dagger; Strohl consults you on deck (Follower rank 4).
Win the runner skirmish — swap Archetypes if anyone is weak to Wind or Ice.
Advise Hulkenberg at the campfire (Follower rank 5).
Runner upkeep, then finish 'Pride and Persuasion' (choice: plead with them).
Eloquence reaches rank 2 (Articulate).
Tomb depth run: grab the Gold Beetle by the ladder and fight through to the Trove.
Catch up with Maria (Follower rank 4).
Hand the ring to Cuculus to complete 'A Dagger, a Ring, and a Rake'; Alonzo makes his pitch (Follower rank 1).
Accompany Strohl to his old home (Follower rank 5); receive 'A Noble's Legacy'.
Debate Lina at the King's Rock (answer: what are your policies?).
Catch up with Maria (Follower rank 5).
Get to know Heismay (Follower rank 2).
Second Spirited Youth challenge — retry until the plunge lands.
Debate Roger at the King's Rock (answer: taxes benefit us all).
Warp to Grand Trad and clear the Mausoleum for the outstanding requests — take the left or right door first at three-door rooms.
Return the necklace to the Resentful Noble, collect the Angry Man's potion, and help Heismay lay his son to rest (Follower rank 3).
Give the King's Rock speech — match the answer to your crowd.
Eloquence reaches rank 3 (Urbane).
Sail for Port Brilehaven; cook Benevolent Bread for the Classy Woman (Maria's perk grants one free travel dish).
Finish 'New World Travel Diary' in the lounge (best response: 'Sounds pretty.').
Cook Critical Meatballs from the worm meat drop.
Play Hulkenberg's game (balance offense and defense), then pass the City Ruins.
Start 'Bygone Days' at the campfire lounge.
Cook Invincible Noodles (or Redgrass Bidou), then continue 'Bygone Days'.
Catherina's runner attacks again — win the rematch (Follower rank 3).
Finish 'Bygone Days'.

Arrive in Brilehaven and collect all five immediately available town Gold Beetles: both Seabreeze Street crate spots, both Merchants' Bazaar crate/alley spots, and the northeast crates at Arenafront Wharf.
Big Bargain Day shopping at Merchants' Bazaar.
Quest warp-around: visit the capital merchant for Strohl's inheritance, then return to Brilehaven.

Martira errands: deliver Benevolent Bread and talk with Bardon (Follower rank 2). If the Visca Alba guest-room Beetle failed to appear on 6/27, recheck the desk/water pitcher now; there are no two new Martira Beetles yet.
Hear the Elegant Performer's music and take the Gambling Man's wager.
Visit the Nightprowler.
Take the ferry to Charadrius — side missions stay open until August 13.

Brilehaven errand sweep: accept and immediately complete 'Efflorescent Youth' with the Rainbow Flower from St. Fermis Church; also accept 'Dental Distress', 'Soldier's Solace', 'Deeds and Diversions', 'Superior Scrimshaw', 'Grieving Ghost of the Goblet', and 'The Chalice vs. The Brew'. Dental Distress expires August 9 and rewards a missable Gold Beetle.
Julian hands over 'The Future of Magic' — collect it now for this route; it remains available through August 13.
Debate Jin at the King's Rock (answer: we should help anyone).
Debate Glodell at the King's Rock (answer: you only parrot Louis).
Accompany Heismay to his village (Follower rank 4).
Before tomorrow's operation, make sure at least 15 distinct Archetypes have been studied for More's Chapter Three task.
At Akademeia, turn in More's Task Chapter Three: Drifting after studying 15 Archetypes — More reaches Follower rank 5 and Chapter Four: Turmoil opens.
Infiltrate Charadrius — a chain of boss battles; Tetrabreak is the one item that matters, set the team from the informant notes.

During Charadrius, defeat Sergeant Xanth to complete 'Obtain Sergeant Xanth's Key', then complete either 'Obtain Maintenance Chief Ceiba's Key' or 'Obtain Master Sergeant Glechom's Key' on the chosen corridor. Only one of the two alternate corridor quests is required for 75/76 quest completion.
Completing Infiltrate the Charadrius automatically raises Gallica to Follower rank 4.
Chat with Bardon (Follower rank 3).
Debate Rudolf at the King's Rock (answer: the tribes must stand together).
Forgiveness Day (30% off): prep dungeon supplies and buy the Archetypal Ring.
Tell Strohl about the inheritance merchant (Follower rank 6).
Tolerance reaches rank 3 (Generous).
Catch the discount at the magic shops.
Debate Milo at the King's Rock (answer: beauty is deeper than our skin).
Bardon shows off his project (Follower rank 4).
Complete 'Defeat the Coliseum Monster' at the coliseum — down the Crag Manjula quickly via its Strike weakness for the 25,000 reeve prize.
Depart on the three-dungeon road trip toward the Tomb of Lament via Inundo; cook Coney Stew; lend Hulkenberg an ear (Follower rank 6).
Inundo stop: buy the Toothbrush of Hygienia for Dental Distress, plus Mellow Milk and the Briny equipment set.
Campfire, then a heart-to-heart with Heismay (Follower rank 5).
Cook Curative Coney Roast, then read 'The Future of Magic' (best response: 'It won't work for everyone.').
Stop by the Peregrine Falls.
Wisdom reaches rank 3 (Knowledgeable).
Tomb of Lament: collect both B2 Gold Beetles via the crawl-space routes and recover Neuras' lost relic.
Show the recovered relic to Neuras: complete 'Relic Search: Dregs of Destiny' (Follower rank 3) and start 'Relic Search: Youth's Folly'.
